vendor/hap is ewilken/hap-rs v0.1.0-pre.15 (commit b13bf31).
Changes from upstream:
- Swap get_if_addrs for if-addrs, so the crate links the system ifaddrs
  library once. See src/config.rs get_local_ip.
- Every service sends its linked services to Home ("linked"), when it has
  any. Upstream left them out, so Home could not group linked services.
- Read the whole request body. Upstream parsed only its first chunk, so a
  request split across frames, like Home's event subscriptions for a TV,
  failed with 500 and Home reconnected without end.
- The switch, air purifier, contact, leak and motion sensor services carry
  Configured Name, which Home labels them by, and follows when it changes.
- Bump the configuration number when the accessory layout changes, not
  only when a new accessory id appears, so Home drops its cached copy.
- Clear the Rust warnings the crate raises.
- Frame the encrypted stream properly. A read that holds part of a frame,
  or several, no longer stalls the connection; a write the socket cannot
  take at once is queued, not dropped; session keys are derived once.
- Send each value change to every controller subscribed to it. Upstream
  gated events on a flag the last controller to subscribe or unsubscribe
  set for all of them, and sent unchanged values too.
- Drop a connection's event listener when it closes, instead of keeping
  every one ever made. Keep serving when one connection fails to accept.
- Answer an unknown characteristic with "resource does not exist".
- Do not panic in mDNS teardown when the responder task has gone first.
- hap is a workspace member, so its tests run with hearth's.
